development_history.scope: Earlier uncommitted execution revision identified by file hashes, not final acceptance
development_history.driver_issue: An earlier run could not write a receipt because WSL git did not resolve the Windows-managed worktree pointer; it is not counted as an acceptance run.

review_fixes: Verify revalidates every signed-integer coordinate, including objects with bypassed constructors.
Random source wrapper validates memoryview.nbytes before passing bytes to shared samplers.
Public/private evaluation handles circuits with only literal constants.
Evidence collection handles Windows-managed worktree identity and checks that source hashes stay fixed during a run.
limits: The toy q=3 profile accepts the public q*e1 forgery and some wrong-context signatures.
BPR hardness parameters, key-input NC1 circuit family and Yu Lemma7 spectral norm guarantee are not admitted.
Finite sampling bounds and explicit deterministic LLL are implementation adaptations; failures are not silently retried.
No formal no-bug claim, production timing guarantee or HIBE/IBME integration.
